ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "OK", issues: sizeOf(vars.rows.issues), epics: sizeOf(vars.rows.epics), blockedIssues: (vars.rows.issues filter ($.STATUS == "Blocked")) map $.ISSUE_KEY, blockedEpics: (vars.rows.epics filter ($.STATUS == "Blocked")) map $.EPIC_KEY }

http:request.doc:name: Search PLAT + IMPL
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { jql: p('jira.jql'), maxResults: p('jira.pageSize') as Number, fields: ["summary", "status", "issuetype", "priority", "labels", "parent", "issuelinks", "customfield_10021", "customfield_10015", "duedate", "resolutiondate", "created", "description"], (nextPageToken: vars.pageToken) if (vars.pageToken != null) }]

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Stage issues
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO MD26_DB.JIRA.ISSUES_STAGE (ISSUE_KEY, PROJECT, EPIC_KEY, CUSTOMER_ID, SUMMARY, ISSUE_TYPE, PRIORITY, STATUS, IS_BLOCKER, BLOCKED_BY, BLOCKED_REASON, ASSIGNEE, CREATED_AT, DUE_DATE, RESOLVED_AT, LAST_MODIFIED) VALUES (:ISSUE_KEY, :PROJECT, :EPIC_KEY, :CUSTOMER_ID, :SUMMARY, :ISSUE_TYPE, :PRIORITY, :STATUS, :IS_BLOCKER, :BLOCKED_BY, :BLOCKED_REASON, :ASSIGNEE, :CREATED_AT, :DUE_DATE, :RESOLVED_AT, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Stage epics
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO MD26_DB.JIRA.EPICS_STAGE (EPIC_KEY, NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_ID, REGION, TARGET_GO_LIVE, STATUS, LAST_MODIFIED) VALUES (:EPIC_KEY, :NAME, :CUSTOMER_ID, :ORDER_ID, :REGION, :TARGET_GO_LIVE, :STATUS, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())

db:insert.doc:name: Swap in issues
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT OVERWRITE INTO MD26_DB.JIRA.ISSUES SELECT * FROM MD26_DB.JIRA.ISSUES_STAGE

db:insert.doc:name: Swap in epics
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT OVERWRITE INTO MD26_DB.JIRA.EPICS SELECT * FROM MD26_DB.JIRA.EPICS_STAGE

logger.message: #['Jira sync: ' ++ (sizeOf(vars.rows.issues) as String) ++ ' issues, ' ++ (sizeOf(vars.rows.epics) as String) ++ ' epics, ' ++ (sizeOf(vars.rows.issues filter ($.STATUS == 'Blocked')) as String) ++ ' blocked']
